text: {"lessons":["I should evaluate each stock as part of my whole portfolio, not as a separate account judged by whether it is above my purchase price.","Taking a gain felt satisfying, but I should not sell a holding just to lock in a win; each decision should reflect its role and my plan.","Because price changes are random and I trade infrequently, I should avoid reading a trend into these few periods and make deliberate decisions rather than reacting to short-term moves."]}
